hook.rumour: Corpse-ships arriving at Zaappi Docks and Necrom's white walls have been turned away after someone stole the ancestral burial charters from the lower ossuaries.
hook.notice: EDICT OF THE KEEPERS OF THE DEAD AT NECROM — Seekers required to recover the stolen Ossuary Roll from the ash-wastes between Alavelis, Camonnaruhn, and Bthar-Zel.
hook.context: Necrom is the white-walled City of the Dead where every Dunmer House brings its ancestors; across the western ash-rivers of Molag Amur, warlike clans and grave-robbers contest the pilgrim roads.

stages.objective: Speak with the Keepers of the Dead in Necrom regarding the missing Ossuary Roll
Inspect the waiting funeral barges moored at Zaappi Docks
Follow the ash-wheel tracks inland to the caravan post at Alavelis

objectives.text: Speak with the Keepers of the Dead in Necrom regarding the missing Ossuary Roll
Inspect the waiting funeral barges moored at Zaappi Docks
Follow the ash-wheel tracks inland to the caravan post at Alavelis

consequence_detail.summary: Witnesses at Zaappi Docks and Alavelis reveal that renegade grave-brokers carried the Ossuary Roll toward Camonnaruhn.

stages.objective: Set out from Alavelis across the basalt ridge toward Camonnaruhn
Clear the outcast raiders occupying Camonnaruhn and recover the bronze reliquary case
Trace the buyers of the missing parchment leaves to the hillside vaults of Bal Sunnar

objectives.text: Set out from Alavelis across the basalt ridge toward Camonnaruhn
Clear the outcast raiders occupying Camonnaruhn and recover the bronze reliquary case
Trace the buyers of the missing parchment leaves to the hillside vaults of Bal Sunnar

consequence_detail.summary: The bronze reliquary case is recovered at Camonnaruhn, and clues at Bal Sunnar point to a necromantic buyer inside Bthar-Zel.

stages.objective: Cross the eastern cinder-wash from Bal Sunnar to the Dwemer citadel of Bthar-Zel
Defeat the bone-binders inside Bthar-Zel and reclaim the intact Ossuary Roll of Necrom
Purge the Daedric shrine-altar at Uhaammu where the stolen ancestor-seals were being profaned

objectives.text: Cross the eastern cinder-wash from Bal Sunnar to the Dwemer citadel of Bthar-Zel
Defeat the bone-binders inside Bthar-Zel and reclaim the intact Ossuary Roll of Necrom
Purge the Daedric shrine-altar at Uhaammu where the stolen ancestor-seals were being profaned

consequence_detail.summary: The intact Ossuary Roll is reclaimed from Bthar-Zel and the shrine-altar at Uhaammu is cleansed.

stages.objective: Signal the waiting funeral barges at Zaappi Docks that the ossuary gates are reopening
Restore the Ossuary Roll to the Keepers of the Dead in the high catacombs of Necrom
Receive the Ash-Lantern Blessing before the white walls of Necrom

objectives.text: Signal the waiting funeral barges at Zaappi Docks that the ossuary gates are reopening
Restore the Ossuary Roll to the Keepers of the Dead in the high catacombs of Necrom
Receive the Ash-Lantern Blessing before the white walls of Necrom

consequence_detail.summary: The Ossuary Roll rests once more in Necrom's catacombs, the funeral barges dock in peace, and all five Great Houses honor your name.
